Prototype 9 encodes W (100% pure) primarily through EEG (59%), with EOG (39%) and EMG (2%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+1.5 dB, sensitivity=10.2) and elevated θ (+0.4 dB, sensitivity=4.2).
The δ activity is present in 17% of each epoch (transient), with moderate eye movements (Blink 69% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with W physiology: confirmed: EMG tonic, EOG active; missing: α elevated+relevant. Note: model primarily uses δ, atypical for W.
